title: feat: add Bee Census survey quest
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bee-census.yml`: a 3-minute survey (who you are, what you build, how you found us, other AI tools, AI spend, spending blockers, payment preferences, disappointment test, magic wand, optional roast and interview opt-in)
- Adds the `bee_census` quest: 3 Quest Pollen, once per GitHub account, paid when the user's own `[Bee Census]` issue exists (lazy GitHub search, same pattern as reported issues)
- Triage workflow skips `[Bee Census]` issues so the AI bot doesn't comment on or close them
- Test covers once-only payment and ignores issues by another GitHub id

Answers can be joined to spend via GitHub id, so the survey doesn't ask what we already know.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The hive takes a census
gist.blurb: Tell us what you’re building in a three-minute Bee Census. Your own completed survey earns 3 Quest Pollen, once per GitHub account.
gist.summary: Added a three-minute Bee Census GitHub issue template and a quest that awards 3 Pollen once per GitHub account when that account submits its own [Bee Census] issue.
gist.impact: People can share how they use Pollinations and earn 3 Quest Pollen for their own survey submission; census issues are also excluded from automated issue triage.
gist.visual_concept: Polli fills out a Bee Census form beside a retro terminal showing a GitHub issue, with three Pollen tokens and small flowers marking the completed quest. The survey is a friendly invitation, not a corporate clipboard exercise.
